snippet.title: Evergrow: Shards of Tomorrow - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Announcement trailer for our upcoming game, Evergrow Shards of Tomorrow.

Check out the Demo and wishlist the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3623600/Evergrow_Shards_of_Tomorrow/

Evergrow: Shards of Tomorrow is a story-driven puzzle-adventure set on a desolate planet shaped by the remains of a long-forgotten civilization. Players take on the role of a small reptilian explorer who arrives in search of a mysterious energy signal, only to uncover the remnants of an ancient conflict between the planet’s inhabitants and the enigmatic Titans of Creation.
Exploration, environmental storytelling, and puzzles form the heart of the experience. Players manipulate objects, operate forgotten machinery, and uncover clues hidden throughout the ruins. Broken murals, ancient relics, abandoned settlements, and remnants of the civilization gradually piece together the story of how this once-thriving world was brought to ruin.
But Evergrow is not only a story about destruction. As players progress, the planet itself begins to change. Life slowly returns to the barren landscape, with vegetation reclaiming forgotten cities and ancient structures. The world’s transformation serves as a reminder that even after devastation, something can endure—and that what is broken may not be lost forever.
Blending atmospheric exploration, mysterious sci-fi, retro-inspired visuals, and a focus on discovery rather than combat, Evergrow: Shards of Tomorrow aims to deliver a thoughtful and visually striking adventure about loss, renewal, and the resilience of life.

#evergrow #indiegame #puzzlegame
